selection_rule: Highest dev Evidence Hit@3 count, then dev Hit@1 count, then fewer indexed chunks, then alphabetical strategy ID. No test labels or test scores used.
audit_rule: First 10 physical content pages sorted by document_id then page; anchor at floor(normalized page length/2); choose earliest char_start chunk covering anchor. Same positions for A/B/C.

hypotheses.A: Fixed windows are simple but may cut conditions and legal clauses.
hypotheses.B: Paragraph packing should preserve legal clauses better; longer chunks may dilute embeddings.
hypotheses.C: Chapter filters supplied in questions may remove off-topic matches; cannot repair broken evidence. C reuses B index and document embeddings.
